_doc: Scripted benchmark scenarios. All user speech is synthesised (benchmarks/synth.py); profiles are the synthetic users in memory/seed_profiles.json. Step kinds: say (speak and wait for the reply), barge_in (speak N seconds into the agent's reply), expect (keyword check on the last agent reply, any-of), expect_opener (keyword check on the proactive opener), expect_summary (keyword check on summary fields).
